The certificate confirms that the engineer deploys TRASSIR OS at a site with up to 32 cameras: configures the server and network, connects cameras, sets archive retention and operator permissions, and completes site handover to the customer. An independent learning concept. The document records completion in this prototype and does not award an official DSSL qualification.
